title: Heavy metal adsorption by graphene oxide modified with 5-amino-3(2-thienyl)pyrazole using central composite design/response surface methodology (CCD/RSM)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36837-36860
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04106F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mobina Alimohammady, Mansour Jahangiri, Masoud Salavati-Niasari, Aseel M. Aljeboree
A GO-based nano-adsorbent was successfully modified with 5-amino-3(2-thienyl)pyrazole (5-ATP-GO). 5-ATP-GO showed high adsorption capacity and selectivity for Cd, Hg and As.
